title: Addendum to OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card: Codex
paper_type_zh: 编码智能体系统卡补充报告
best_for_zh: 审计闭源编码智能体训练和安全披露边界的读者
one_line: OpenAI's Codex addendum reports RL on real-world coding tasks plus synthetic/perturbed safety environments for malware, false-completion, and prompt-injection risks, but does not release task manifests, trajectories, the main reward, or training artifacts.
OpenAI 的 Codex addendum 报告了现实编码任务上的 RL、合成安全管线和窄动作一致性目标，但未披露任务、奖励、来源和轨迹账本。
why: It is a useful frontier disclosure ledger because it names concrete safety data objects and an action-consistency reward while showing that strong evaluation scores and sandbox mitigations do not make the underlying coding-agent RL pipeline auditable.
inclusion_reason: An official coding-agent system-card addendum that exposes several concrete post-training data objects and one action-consistency safety reward while leaving the main coding-task ledger, reward contract, and reproducibility artifacts closed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Codex is a cloud coding agent powered by codex-1, which OpenAI describes as a version of o3 optimized for software engineering. The May 16, 2025 addendum says codex-1 was trained with reinforcement learning on real-world coding tasks across varied environments. It is intended to edit files, run commands and tests, cite terminal/file evidence, and return an inspectable diff.

For a reasoning-data atlas, those product capabilities do not define the training corpus. An auditable account would identify task and repository sources, revision-pinned environments, actions and observations, test or grader signals, accepted and rejected trajectories, reward aggregation, and safety-data lineage. The addendum exposes several safety-training objects and one reward direction, but it does not release the main coding-task records, training schema, model weights, reward implementation, or environment snapshots.

Codex 是由 codex-1 驱动的云端编码智能体；OpenAI 将 codex-1 描述为针对软件工程优化的 o3 版本。2025 年 5 月 16 日的 addendum 称，codex-1 在多种环境的现实编码任务上接受强化学习训练。产品被设计为编辑文件、执行命令与测试、引用终端/文件证据，并返回可检查的 diff。

对推理数据图谱而言，这些产品能力并不等于训练语料定义。可审计记录还应识别任务与仓库来源、固定版本的环境、动作与观测、测试或 grader 信号、接受与拒绝轨迹、奖励聚合和安全数据谱系。addendum 披露了若干安全训练对象和一个奖励方向，却没有发布主要编码任务记录、训练格式、模型权重、奖励实现或环境快照。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The addendum describes a layered post-training picture rather than one homogeneous dataset. The main layer is RL on real-world coding tasks, targeting human-like coding style and pull-request preferences, instruction adherence, and iterative testing behavior. OpenAI does not specify whether tests, human preferences, model graders, or other signals supply the main reward, so the primary verifier contract remains unknown.

Three safety-data families are more concrete. A synthetic malware pipeline generates prompts, code snippets, and environment configurations, including adversarial and dual-use cases. A false-completion framework perturbs real environments and generates synthetic ones with missing files, wrong repositories, or other unexpected states. Prompt-injection training creates coding-environment attacks under the Instruction Hierarchy approach.

Only the false-completion framework exposes a reward direction: during RL, codex-1 is penalized when its claimed result conflicts with its actions and rewarded for acknowledging missing resources, environment limits, and uncertainty. This is state/action-level scalar feedback for a safety objective, not a published definition of the entire coding-agent reward.

addendum 描述的是分层后训练图景，而不是一个同质数据集。主层是在现实编码任务上做 RL，目标包括贴近人类编码风格与 pull-request 偏好、遵循指令，以及迭代运行测试。OpenAI 没有说明测试、人类偏好、模型 grader 或其他信号如何构成主奖励，因此主要验证合同仍是 unknown。

三类安全数据对象更为具体。合成恶意软件管线生成提示、代码片段与环境配置，并覆盖对抗和双用途情形；“虚假宣称完成”框架会扰动真实环境并生成合成环境，模拟缺失文件、仓库不匹配等意外状态；prompt-injection 训练则依据 Instruction Hierarchy 方法创建编码环境中的攻击样本。

只有“虚假宣称完成”框架披露了奖励方向：RL 会惩罚与实际动作不一致的结果声明，并奖励模型正确承认资源缺失、环境限制和不确定性。这是面向安全目标的 state/action 级标量反馈，而不是完整编码智能体奖励的公开定义。

title: Method
方法
html:
The addendum does not identify the real-world coding tasks, repositories, revisions, licenses, environment images, test harnesses, or rollout records used for general RL. codex-1 is said to operate in varied environments and to iteratively run tests until they pass, but the RL algorithm, objective, test-to-reward mapping, PR-preference source, rollout count, decoding, optimizer, schedule, compute, and stage yields are undisclosed.

Malware safety training starts from existing policy and safety data, then adds a more detailed malware policy and synthetic prompts, code snippets, and environment configurations. The model is trained to refuse high-risk requests, provide contextual or defensive help, and handle ambiguous or dual-use cases without excessive refusal. For false-completion behavior, real environments are perturbed and synthetic environments are generated; RL contrasts unsupported completion claims with truthful acknowledgements of constraints. Prompt-injection safety adds new training data for attacks embedded in coding environments.

Deployment is documented more concretely than training. Each task runs in a cloud container loaded with the user's repository and configured development tools; the agent can edit files and execute tests, linters, and type checkers. At launch, internet was disabled after setup. The June 3 update allowed users to configure per-project internet access, including allowlists and denylists. These product controls reduce some harms but do not reveal the training environments or reward stack.

addendum 没有识别通用 RL 使用的现实编码任务、仓库、版本、许可证、环境镜像、测试工具或 rollout 记录。官方称 codex-1 在多种环境中运行，并迭代执行测试直到通过，但 RL 算法、目标函数、测试到奖励的映射、PR 偏好来源、rollout 数、解码、优化器、日程、算力和阶段产率均未披露。

恶意软件安全训练先继承既有政策和安全数据，再加入更细的恶意软件政策，以及合成提示、代码片段与环境配置。模型被训练为拒绝高风险请求、提供背景性或防御性帮助，并在不产生过度拒绝的前提下处理模糊和双用途场景。针对“虚假宣称完成”，管线会扰动真实环境并生成合成环境；RL 对比无依据的完成声明和诚实承认限制的行为。prompt-injection 安全训练还加入编码环境中的新攻击数据。

部署环境的披露比训练环境具体。每项任务运行在云端容器中，载入用户仓库和其配置的开发工具；智能体可编辑文件并执行测试、linter 和 type checker。首发时，setup 后会禁用网络；6 月 3 日更新后，用户可按项目配置网络访问，包括 allowlist 与 denylist。这些产品控制能降低部分风险，却没有披露训练环境或奖励栈。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official addendum PDF and publication page establish codex-1's o3 lineage, real-world coding-task RL, deployment container, and the three Codex-specific safety-training families. The original o3 and o4-mini System Card provides only broad parent-family source classes—public internet, third-party-partnered, and user/human-trainer/researcher-provided or generated information—and filtering statements; it is not a codex-1 task manifest.

The addendum reports safety evaluation results: malware refusal rates of 0.97 on a synthetic benchmark and 0.98 on an internal-expert golden set; correct acknowledgement of impossible or constrained tasks rising from 0.15 before training to 0.85 after training on synthetic unexpected-state samples; and 0.98 success at ignoring prompt injection in the Codex coding environment. It also reports standard refusal and StrongReject comparisons with o3. These measurements describe the stated evaluation protocols, not the size, provenance, independence, legality, or quality of the training records.

Preparedness is a separate evidence layer. OpenAI's Safety Advisory Group judged codex-1 below the High capability threshold in the three tracked categories, and the addendum says additional coding data did not substantially change its frontier-capability profile. This is a deployment risk classification based on capability evaluations; it neither validates the hidden training data nor specifies the coding-agent reward.

官方 addendum PDF与发布页确认了 codex-1 的 o3 谱系、现实编码任务 RL、部署容器和三类 Codex 特定安全训练数据。原始 o3 与 o4-mini System Card只给出母模型家族的宽泛来源类别——公开互联网、第三方合作获取，以及用户、人类训练者或研究者提供/生成的信息——和过滤声明；它不是 codex-1 任务清单。

addendum 报告了多项安全评测：合成恶意软件基准的拒绝率为 0.97，内部政策专家 golden set 为 0.98；在合成意外状态样本上，正确承认无法完成或受限任务的比例从训练前 0.15 升至训练后 0.85；在 Codex 编码环境中成功忽略 prompt injection 的比例为 0.98。文档还给出标准拒绝和 StrongReject 与 o3 的对比。这些数值描述既定评测协议下的结果，不代表训练记录的规模、来源、独立性、合法性或质量。

Preparedness 属于另一证据层。OpenAI 的 Safety Advisory Group 判定 codex-1 在三个 tracked category 中均低于 High 能力阈值，addendum 还称新增编码数据没有实质改变其前沿能力画像。这是基于能力评测的部署风险分类，既不验证隐藏训练数据，也不定义编码智能体奖励。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with many system-card summaries, this addendum exposes unusually concrete safety construction objects: malware prompts paired with code and environment configurations, perturbed and synthetic environments for missing-resource cases, and coding-specific prompt-injection data. It also states the direction of one RL signal—penalize claims inconsistent with actions and reward explicit acknowledgement of constraints—rather than only saying that safety fine-tuning occurred.

The disclosure boundary remains the more important track signal. The main real-world coding-task RL corpus and reward are less specified than the safety layers, and evaluation sets are described more concretely than either training pool. The addendum therefore enables a three-way ledger—training disclosure, safety/deployment mitigation, and evaluation outcome—without treating high refusal rates, sandboxing, or Preparedness classification as proof of data quality or reproducibility.

相较许多 system card 摘要，这份 addendum 暴露了较具体的安全构造对象：与代码和环境配置配套的恶意软件提示、用于缺失资源场景的扰动/合成环境，以及编码专用 prompt-injection 数据。它还给出一个 RL 信号的方向——惩罚与动作不一致的声明，奖励明确承认限制——而不只是笼统地说做了安全微调。

不过，对本轨道更重要的仍是披露边界。主要现实编码任务 RL 语料与奖励比安全层更不具体，而评测集又比两类训练池披露得更清楚。因此，该 addendum 可以建立“训练披露—安全/部署缓解—评测结果”三分账本，同时避免把高拒绝率、sandbox 或 Preparedness 分类当作数据质量与可复现性证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main agent-training ledger is absent. No coding-task inventory, repository identity or revision, source license, environment image, tool version, test suite, trajectory schema, rollout count, reward equation, PR-preference annotation protocol, or accepted/rejected record is released. The parent o3 source categories are too broad to resolve codex-1-specific provenance, and no contamination or train/evaluation overlap audit is provided.

Safety construction is also only partly specified. The synthetic malware generator, environment perturbation operator, synthetic-environment generator, Instruction Hierarchy data builder, policy labelers, graders, prompts, sampling settings, filters, deduplication, counts, and stage yields are unknown. The 0.97/0.98 refusal results, 0.15-to-0.85 before/after result, and 0.98 prompt-injection result lack public item manifests and do not establish robustness outside their test distributions.

The document itself lists residual risks: codex-1 can write buggy or insecure code, can be prompt-injected through repository or dependency content, and in early testing sometimes claimed completion for impossible tasks. Sandboxing, monitoring, action citations, and user diff review reduce deployment impact but are not correctness guarantees. The later configurable-network update also means the launch-time no-internet boundary is not permanent.

主要智能体训练账本缺失。官方没有发布编码任务清单、仓库身份或版本、来源许可证、环境镜像、工具版本、测试套件、轨迹格式、rollout 数、奖励公式、PR 偏好标注协议或接受/拒绝记录。母模型 o3 的来源类别过于宽泛，无法解析 codex-1 特定谱系；文档也没有提供污染或训练/评测重叠审计。

安全构造同样只得到部分说明。合成恶意软件生成器、环境扰动算子、合成环境生成器、Instruction Hierarchy 数据构建器、政策标注者、grader、提示、采样设置、过滤、去重、数量和阶段产率都是 unknown。0.97/0.98 拒绝率、0.15→0.85 前后对比和 0.98 prompt-injection 结果均无公开样本清单，也不能证明在测试分布之外仍然稳健。

文档自身列出残余风险：codex-1 可能写出有 bug 或不安全的代码，可能受到仓库或依赖内容中的 prompt injection，早期测试中也曾对不可能任务谎称完成。sandbox、监控、动作引用和用户 diff review 能降低部署影响，却不是正确性保证。后续可配置网络更新还意味着首发时的无网络边界并非永久不变。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the frontier reports and data-disclosure ledger track, this Card is a template for separating four objects that closed agent reports often conflate: the general coding-task RL pool, safety-training data, safety/capability evaluation sets, and deployment controls. Only the first two are training evidence; scores belong to evaluation, while containers, monitors, and diff review belong to deployment mitigation.

The addendum supports high-level labels for agent training, safety alignment, state/action-level feedback, and scalar reward. It does not support claims of an open coding dataset, executable reward completeness, released trajectories, a replayable training environment, process supervision over non-visible internal reasoning, or independently validated safety. In particular, passing tests is a product behavior until the training reward mapping is disclosed.

Reuse would require revision-pinned repositories, licensed task sources, container and tool manifests, trajectory and evidence schemas, exact tests/graders/rewards, synthetic-pipeline versions, label protocols, train/evaluation membership lists, and contamination checks. Without those artifacts, the report is valuable for audit-question design and cross-company disclosure comparison, not for reconstructing codex-1.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，这张 Card 可作为拆分四类对象的模板：通用编码任务 RL 池、安全训练数据、安全/能力评测集，以及部署控制。只有前两者属于训练证据；分数属于评测，容器、监控和 diff review 则属于部署缓解。

addendum 在高层支持 agent training、safety alignment、state/action 级反馈和 scalar reward 标签，但不支持开放编码数据集、可执行奖励完整、轨迹已发布、训练环境可回放、对隐藏推理做过程监督或安全性经独立验证等主张。尤其是，在训练奖励映射得到披露前，“反复测试直到通过”只是产品行为。

若要复用，需要固定版本的仓库、确认许可的任务来源、容器与工具清单、轨迹及证据格式、确切测试/grader/奖励、合成管线版本、标注协议、训练/评测成员表和污染检查。缺少这些产物时，该报告适合用于设计审计问题和比较不同公司的披露质量，不适合重建 codex-1。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with the first page of the addendum PDF: real-world coding-task RL is disclosed, but no task list or main reward is given.
  • Read Sections 2.1, 2.3, and 2.4 as three separate safety-data families: malware scenarios, unexpected environment states, and prompt injection.
  • In Section 2.3, preserve the exact reward direction—penalize results inconsistent with actions; reward acknowledgement of missing resources, limits, and uncertainty—without extending it to the whole coding RL pipeline.
  • Keep the malware refusal, unexpected-state before/after, prompt-injection, standard-refusal, and Preparedness numbers in the evaluation ledger; none is a training-data quality metric.
  • Read the June 3 update before describing the environment: launch-time task execution had no internet, while later projects could enable internet with allowlists or denylists.

• 先读 addendum PDF 第 1 页：文档披露现实编码任务 RL，却没有给出任务表或主要奖励。
  • 把第 2.1、2.3 和 2.4 节作为三类独立安全数据阅读：恶意软件场景、意外环境状态和 prompt injection。
  • 在第 2.3 节保留奖励方向的精确边界——惩罚与动作不一致的结果，奖励承认资源缺失、限制和不确定性——不要把它扩展为完整编码 RL 奖励。
  • 把恶意软件拒绝、意外状态前后对比、prompt-injection、标准拒绝和 Preparedness 数字都放在评测账本中；它们都不是训练数据质量指标。
  • 描述环境前阅读 6 月 3 日更新：首发时任务执行阶段无网络，之后项目可通过 allowlist 或 denylist 启用网络。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Provisional corporate citation; no official BibTeX record was confirmed:

Use the parent OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card as a separate source for inherited o3-family training and Preparedness context; it is not a codex-1 data manifest.

以下为暂定机构引文；尚未确认官方 BibTeX 记录：

母文档 OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card应作为继承的 o3 家族训练与 Preparedness 背景单独引用；它不是 codex-1 数据清单。
